description: Alpha-weighted squared Euclidean distance between current replay logits and stored pre-softmax logits, summed across classes and reduced across the replay batch; implements the replay term in Paper §3 Eq. (5).

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def replay_pairs(ctx):
 features = torch.randn(4, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
 stored_logits = torch.randn(2, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
 return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(features), "targets": synth.Tensor(stored_logits)}
ds = synth.Spec("der-replay", generator=replay_pairs, size=8, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("regression", split="train", input_field="inputs", target_field="targets", preserve_shape=True)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=4, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="regression", recipe_config={"loss": "der-replay", "loss_kwargs": {"alpha": 0.5}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train on replay samples with stored logits

name: Dark Experience Replay logit regularizer

parameters.ignore_index: must be None because targets are stored logits
parameters.reduction: none returns one value per sample; mean or sum reduces across the batch (default mean)

usage: Trainer(model, loader, recipe='regression', recipe_config={'loss':'der-replay','loss_kwargs':{'alpha':0.5}}); samples represent items already drawn from the replay buffer
